concerns.text: FR‑014 is defined in the specification (User Story 2 acceptance scenario) but no task in tasks.md references or implements this requirement.

SC‑001 (dataset‑completeness validation) is not addressed by any task; there is no task that counts records per crossing number, checks null‑percentage ≤ 5 %, or cross‑checks against the Hoste‑Thistlethwaite‑Weeks enumeration.
SC‑006 (handling of ambiguous or missing alternating/non‑alternating classification) has no corresponding task; edge‑case handling for classification is absent.
SC‑008 (core‑invariant coverage documentation) is not covered; no task generates an invariant‑coverage report for crossing number and braid index.
SC‑009 (descriptive comparison metrics: mean difference, variance ratio, Cohen’s d) is not linked to any task; the required calculations and documentation are missing.
SC‑010 (absolute tolerance 1 × 10⁻⁶ for consistency checks) is not explicitly mentioned in any task; tasks T016/T017 reference match rates but omit the required tolerance specification.

SC‑014 (core‑invariant precision consistency for crossing number and braid index) is not directly addressed; while T016 mentions SC‑015, there is no task that explicitly validates core‑invariant precision against KnotInfo with the 1e‑6 tolerance.
SC‑005 (≥ 95 % of computable invariants populated for Phase 2+) is absent; no task measures or reports this completeness metric for additional invariants.

SC‑011 (residual analysis identification of families deviating ≥ 2 SD) is only partially covered; while T041b and T028 run residual analysis, there is no explicit task that documents the ≥ 2 SD threshold and produces the required family‑level report.

SC‑012 (validation‑scope document must contain crossing‑number ≤10 vs ≤13 distinction and counts table) is only referenced in T010, but T010’s deliverable does not guarantee the required table and justification are present.

SC‑015 (core‑invariant precision consistency with ≥ 90 % match) is referenced by T016, but T016’s verification description (“Match rate ≥ 90 %”) lacks an explicit statement that the tolerance is 1e‑6, which is required by SC‑010 and SC‑015.

SC‑016 (scatter‑plot validation) is covered by T041c and T149, but the tasks do not explicitly verify the ≥ 95 % data‑point visibility criterion; the verification steps only mention resolution and metadata.
FR‑014 (measurement‑precision standard for core invariants) is mentioned in the specification but no task explicitly implements a precision‑validation module or reports its results.
FR‑015 is referenced in the specification (User Story 2) but there is no task that implements the measurement‑precision standard for core invariants as required.
FR‑016 does not exist in the specification, yet no task references it; this indicates a possible stale tag in the task list (e.g., T084 mentions a validator but does not cite an FR).
